contexts.text: If (at the end of the Church) they do not approach the Lord Himself, and live according to His precepts, they are left by the Lord; and, when left by the Lord, they become as pagans, who have no religion... Signified.

(Thus) pagans who acknowledge God, and live according to the civil laws of justice, are saved; for it is not their fault that they do not know anything about the Lord, and consequently not anything about the chastity of marriage with one wife...
They are carried to the extremity of the Christian world, and are commingled with pagans.
Say such things to any pagan who has judgment...
They emit them, and live paganly.
From being a pagan the man becomes a Christian.
All who do what is good from religion, not only Christians, but also pagans, are accepted by the Lord...
Their worship will remain, not as the worship of any Church, but as the worship of paganism; and therefore (the Babylonians) after death come among pagans.
They are not unlike upright pagans...
